links.reported_relation: Snapshot insertion computes timePassed from block.timestamp, which is frozen during sequencer downtime, so snapshots are written with cumulative values not reflecting the real time gap.
Trades execute at manipulated prices after restart and those corrupted prices get locked into the oracle TWAP history, enabling loss of funds from liquidations/trades.
The snapshot insertion logic ignores L2 sequencer status, so the oracle does not validate sequencer uptime before recording snapshots.
